title: chrysopogon secundus
intro: Chrysopogon secundus, commonly known as Vettiver or Khus-khus, is a type of grass native to India and Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Chrysopogon secundus include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, making it useful for treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of Chrysopogon secundus include essential oils, specifically khusimone and vetiverol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
